nodes.label: v2 pipeline stage table
nodes.rationale: One glanceable contract of stage, role, model and type so contributors place logic in the right node instead of growing the orchestrator.

nodes.label: Rolling memory and TTL
nodes.rationale: Bounded context plus timed expiry trades perfect recall for predictable cost: recent turns stay verbatim, older history compacts via summarizer and vector drain.

nodes.label: Concurrency and edge cases
nodes.rationale: Semaphore cap plus memory backpressure plus force-to-story terminators keep 100+ concurrent storms and router overruns from cascading.
